name: Blender
about: Free 3D modelling, sculpting, animation and rendering.

landmarks.name: 3D Viewport
landmarks.what: where you model; Tab swaps Object and Edit Mode

landmarks.name: Properties
landmarks.where: bottom right, with a column of tab icons

landmarks.name: Add
landmarks.where: viewport header, top left of the 3D view

recipes.say: In Blender a fillet is a Bevel.

steps.do: Press Tab for Edit Mode
Press 2 for edge select and pick the edges
Press Ctrl+B and drag; scroll the wheel for more segments
Open the spanner (Modifiers) tab in Properties, bottom right
Add Modifier, Generate, Bevel
Turn up Segments and turn on Harden Normals for clean shading
With the mouse over the viewport press Shift+A, or use Add in the header
Pick Mesh, then the shape
Press F12 to render (or Render, Render Image)
In the render window, Image, Save As
Pick PNG as the file format on the right and save
Select what you want to export
File, Export, FBX
Tick Selected Objects under Include, then Export
File, Export, glTF 2.0
Choose glTF Binary (.glb) for one tidy file
In Object Mode right-click the object
Pick Shade Auto Smooth (or Shade Smooth)
Open the spanner (Modifiers) tab in Properties
Add Modifier, Generate, Mirror
Tick Clipping so the middle stays joined
In Object Mode press Ctrl+2 to add a Subdivision Surface at level 2
Tab into Edit Mode and press 3 for face select
Select the face and press E, then move the mouse
In Edit Mode press Ctrl+R and hover an edge
Scroll for more cuts, click, then slide and click again

recipes.say: Weird bevels and modifiers are usually unapplied scale.

steps.do: In Object Mode press Ctrl+A
Pick Scale (or All Transforms)
Object menu, Set Origin, Origin to Geometry
steps.click: Object > Set Origin > Origin to Geometry

steps.do: Tab into Edit Mode and press A to select all
Press U and pick Smart UV Project for a quick unwrap
Open the Material tab (red ball) in Properties
Click New, then change Base Color
Select the objects, the main one last
Press Ctrl+J
In Edit Mode select the part
Press P and pick Selection
Open the spanner (Modifiers) tab
Add Modifier, Generate, Array
Press Numpad 0 to look through the camera
To move the camera to your view, press Ctrl+Alt+Numpad 0
Press Numpad . (period) to zoom to what's selected
Or press Home to see everything

glossary.Modifier: A non-destructive effect stacked on an object (Bevel, Mirror, Array, Subdivision).
glossary.Origin: The orange dot an object rotates and scales around.
glossary.Edit Mode: Where you change vertices, edges and faces. Tab toggles it.
glossary.Apply: Bake a modifier or transform into the mesh for good.

tips: Ctrl+A, Scale before bevelling. Unapplied scale makes bevels lopsided.
A Bevel modifier with Harden Normals gives clean hard-surface shading for free.
Mirror modifier with Clipping on lets you model one half and keeps the seam closed.
Shift+D duplicates, Alt+D makes a linked copy that updates with the original.
Numpad . zooms to the selection when you lose something.
F3 searches every command by name if you forget where something lives.
Ctrl+S early, Ctrl+S often. Blender's autosave lives under File, Recover.
